reason: I already order through an app from Erbil that has worked fine for me, so I don't see why I'd switch to a new name nobody I know has tried. Paying 21,000 in fees on 30,000 shoes is a lot of my money for a service I can't trust yet.
objection: If the size is wrong or it looks different from the picture, I can't return it because they say no change-of-mind returns, and I don't know if a new company will really refund me when something arrives damaged.
would_change_my_mind: A friend or a page I follow ordering from them and showing the item arrived exactly as in the warehouse photo, plus a refund I could see them actually give.
